svg.title: JARVIS architecture
svg.desc: A wake word and speech recognition feed a supervisor that delegates to eight specialist agents. Every action passes a permission gate before 11 MCP servers act on the Windows PC. A model router connects Claude, OpenAI, Gemini and Ollama.
